body:
One night 2 of my friends came over to sell me some ganj. We sat around and talked for a lil bit and they said they had a bottle full of this pill called Elavil. I had never heard of it so I asked them what it did. They told me it made you feel like your legs were jello, almost as if you were on a an elevator. So as curious as I was I bought a couple to test.
Next day at school as soon as I got there a friend asked if I needed any drugs. I'm always down for being fucked up so I bought a bar. I sat through about half the period and left to go to the bathroom. I popped the Xanax and Elavil then went back to class. When I got to second period I sold a friend an Elavil and told him about it since he had never heard of it either. About 5 mins after I sat down I began to feel some effects. I got up to sharpen my pencil and felt my legs go numb and wobbly as if I were drunk. Throughout the rest of the class period I would fall asleep, have this really random dream and wake up. The same thing happened about 12 more times till 2nd period was over and I was being awakened by a classmate.
When I got to 3rd period we were doing autobiographys so my teacher handed out laptops. As soon as I got mine I went back to my laptop and fell asleep at the keyboard....Then some how I woke up as everyone was getting up to go to lunch. Instead of going to lunch turns out I went to the bathroom stall to sleep. I woke up in a dazed state completely lost and wondering why I was in the bathroom. After a couple moments of thought I remember what I took and how I ended up in the bathroom. I walked out still feeling fucked up as shit and went into the snack room. The clock read 2:45 which ment it was 20 mins before 4th period was over. I had missed lunch and 30 mins of 3rd period. I was too scared to go into 3rd to get my books so I pretty much sat in the bathroom until the bell rang to go home. When I got home I fell asleep in my bed and woke up at about 10:00 pm to get in the shower. When I got out I went back to bed and was out for the rest of the night.
The next day I went to school and found out that the friend that I gave an Elavil got caught fucked up by the sec. Cop. Turns out he cussed out the principal and only got suspended for 3 days. Never got into any trouble about skipping the rest of 3rd and skipping 4th.
This Experience was fairly dull, wouldn't really recommend taking Elavil unless you wanna be tired as shit as that is its purpose.
